images.caption: The Meistersaal at Köthener Straße No. 38 in Berlin-Kreuzberg. The building was constructed in 1912 by the architects Gieseke and Wenzke as office building for the Union of Building Companies of Berlin and Outer Boroughs. The name is derived from the chamber music hall in the building, where the master craftsman certificates were originally presented. The building has been designated as a cultural heritage monument.
